title: Quant pipeline integration smoke for legacy LLM variants
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Integrate INT8 weight-only quantization profiles (GPTQ and AWQ variants) for a set of legacy LLM family members into the CI/Canary pipeline and establish a lightweight smoke/regression suite that flags numerical drift, answer-quality regressions, and stability regressions before model rollouts. This ticket harmonizes calibration runs, numeric diffs, and telemetry gating so we can safely surface candidate quantized profiles to canaries and Dedicated lanes.
acceptance_criteria: A reproducible calibration workflow is available that produces a profile artifact (profile id) for both GPTQ and AWQ on target legacy models
CI job 'quant-smoke-legacy' runs on every profile artifact creation and returns green within 45 minutes on median for target models
Numeric delta guardrails implemented: token-level perplexity and answer-AUROC difference thresholds configurable per model family
Golden-seed determinism: on fixed seed and dataset, quantized outputs reproduce within configured tolerance on 90% of prompts
Canary rollout gating: if smoke job fails or numeric thresholds exceeded, automatic hold and Slack alert to #platform-quant-alerts
Performance guardrail: latency regression < 15% p95 compared to float baseline for batch sizes 1-4 on representative hardware
Automated rollback playbook documented and linked in the monitoring runbook
implementation_plan: 1) Define canonical legacy model set (Llama-2-13B-legacy, Redstone-7B-legacy, and internal-v1) and sample prompt corpus
2) Standardize profile artifact format: profile.json + metadata (quant-type, calibration-seed, dataset-hash, build-trace) and store in profiles-registry
3) Build 'quant-smoke-legacy' CI job that takes profile artifact, runs inference comparator against float baseline, computes numeric deltas, and emits metrics to telemetry
4) Add deterministic calibration harness wrapping existing GPTQ/AWQ libs with reproducible RNG and dataset sharding for speed
5) Wire CI job results to canary gating logic in rollout-controller and add automatic Slack notifications and Sentry issues for failures
6) Create minimal dashboard widget showing per-profile numeric diffs, p95 latency delta, and recent runs in Console under model-health/quant-smoke
test_matrix: Hardware: A100-40G, T4, ampere-like dedicated pools used by Dedicated staging
Metrics: token-perplexity-delta, normalized-answer-emd, p95-latency-delta, mem-usage, model-output-stability-score
monitoring_and_playbook: If numeric-delta > model-specific threshold: mark profile 'quarantine' and open ENG ticket with trace and diff bundle
If latency p95 regression > 15%: auto-assign to runtime perf team and nominate kernel swap investigation
If golden-seed reproducibility fails: schedule re-calibration with secondary seed and call out to research for AWQ hyper-params
Slack alerts: #platform-quant-alerts for severity-high; #platform-quant for informational successes
Runbook: steps to revert canary to previous float/baseline model, how to run local reproducer, and how to escalate numeric drift to product quality
